skill.name: video-edit
skill.description: Routes video editing requests to RunComfy models for restyling, background changes, packaging swaps, motion transfer, and outfit edits through the local RunComfy CLI.
skill.summary: Route video edits to the right RunComfy model with focused prompts and CLI guidance.
skill.author: doany-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are markdown code spans, parameter names, placeholder URLs, or documentation links. Confirmed risks are intentional RunComfy CLI execution, global CLI installation guidance, persistent token storage, and third-party media processing.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the RunComfy CLI version, show commands before execution, and require user confirmation before running install or edit jobs.
Document token revocation, prefer `RUNCOMFY_TOKEN` for temporary sessions, and verify owner-only permissions on stored token files.
Warn users before sending private videos or image URLs to RunComfy, and require consent for sensitive or regulated media.

content.value_statement: Video edits often require choosing the right model before writing prompts. This skill routes restyles, motion transfer, and outfit swaps to RunComfy models with targeted guidance.
actual_capabilities: Routes general video restyles, background swaps, and packaging swaps to Wan 2.7 Edit-Video.
Routes reference motion transfer requests to Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control.
Routes lightweight outfit and lighting edits to Lucy Edit Restyle.
Provides RunComfy CLI command patterns for each supported model route.
Documents model limits for duration, resolution, audio handling, and aspect ratio.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and valid authentication.
Requires source videos or images as accessible URLs for remote processing.
Cannot blend multiple RunComfy routes in one request.
Model limits vary by route for duration, resolution, and aspect ratio control.

use_cases.title: Restyle Marketing Clips
use_cases.description: Change a product video background or lighting while preserving camera motion and source audio.

use_cases.title: Transfer Character Motion
use_cases.description: Map motion from a reference clip onto a target character with identity consistency.

use_cases.title: Refresh Social Video Looks
use_cases.description: Apply outfit, lighting, or scene restyles to short clips without rebuilding the full video workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Background Edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner restyle request with one clear change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this video to preserve the subject, pose, and motion. Change only the background to a clean studio setting.

prompt_templates.title: Product Packaging Swap
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a reference image for a direct visual replacement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the source video and reference package image. Keep framing and hand motion stable, and replace only the packaging design.

prompt_templates.title: Reference Motion Transfer
prompt_templates.scenario: Route a motion-control job to the Kling model.
prompt_templates.prompt: Transfer the motion from the reference clip onto the target character. Keep the character identity stable and preserve the original sound.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Route Selection
prompt_templates.scenario: Ask the skill to choose the best RunComfy route before execution.
prompt_templates.prompt: Classify this edit request, choose the best RunComfy model, explain the routing choice, then prepare the command for review.

output_examples.input: A talking-head clip needs a modern office background and original audio kept.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Wan 2.7 Edit-Video, prioritizes face and lip movement preservation, and prepares a RunComfy edit command for review.

output_examples.input: A character image should follow the dance motion from a reference clip.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control and frames the request around motion transfer, identity hold, and sound preservation.

output_examples.input: A short portrait clip needs warmer lighting and the same subject identity.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Lucy Edit Restyle and keeps the prompt focused on one localized lighting change with identity preservation.

best_practices: Use one edit direction per request to reduce drift and preserve motion.
Put preservation goals before the requested visual change in the prompt.
Review generated RunComfy commands before execution, especially when media is private.
anti_patterns: Do not combine restyle, motion transfer, and packaging replacement in one call.
Do not pass reference images unless the edit needs direct appearance transfer.
Do not send sensitive media URLs without user approval and RunComfy account authorization.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It routes video edit requests to RunComfy models and provides model-specific prompt and CLI guidance.

faq.question: Which RunComfy models does it use?
faq.answer: It uses Wan 2.7 Edit-Video, Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control, and Lucy Edit Restyle.

faq.question: Does it edit files locally?
faq.answer: No. It prepares RunComfy CLI jobs that send requests to RunComfy cloud services.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: Most routes need a source video URL, a clear edit prompt, and an authenticated RunComfy CLI session.

faq.question: Can it preserve original audio?
faq.answer: Yes. Supported routes document audio preservation options when the model allows them.

faq.question: Is it suitable for private videos?
faq.answer: Use caution. The skill sends media URLs to RunComfy, so private or regulated content needs explicit approval.
